testResults.result: 2076 passed, 13 skipped, 1 xfailed at wave edit freeze; the task touches no Python runtime code, so the shared suite plus workflow checks are the focused evidence

testResults.name: workflow-validation
testResults.result: Both workflows parse cleanly; reusable-workflow contract (image-digest input, needs chain to publish-image output), SHA-pinned actions, zero secrets references, concurrency groups, and the trap-guarded private-ingress probe all validated by the T113 checklist

testResults.name: live-deploy-with-quant-smoke
testResults.command: push of commits 6ce2b2f, 4e08750, f000546, 4485075, 50083b2, e4fb026; deploy-main run 34188517611
testResults.result: AC1/AC2 proven live: publish-image built one immutable digest, deploy imported it to the private ACR and updated every quant runtime (quant API, RTH trader, backtest job) by digest-pinned reference verified by the smoke's digest step; the smoke used OIDC only (no Azure client secrets) and every step succeeded: digest pinning, ingress and storage posture, quant API health, bounded synthetic backtest smoke, trader revision health

testResults.name: incident-fixes-landed-in-wave
testResults.result: Live-run findings fixed inside the wave: the backtest job template now bakes the in-image smoke config (az containerapp job start --args cannot pass leading-dash tokens and its --yaml override drops container args); the runtime image now ships the strategies package (Dockerfile + .dockerignore); the runtime user has a writable .local artifact root; deploy-main redeploys on .dockerignore changes

limitations: Trader revision health remains reported, not enforced: the RTH trader revision is expected degraded until the operator seeds the shared Alpaca credential pair and the first supervised session runs (see h5-quant-smoke.md and trader-operations.md)
